"ASTARTES: ALIEN EXTERMINATION

Third-Person Sci-Fi Survival Shooter

Create a fully playable 3D third-person shooter game based on a futuristic military organization called ASTARTES.

The player controls a powerful ASTARTES soldier wearing massive futuristic black power armor made from an extremely resistant material called Aegisium.

The objective is to survive increasingly difficult waves of alien creatures, eliminate enemies, collect rewards, upgrade the character and become an increasingly powerful soldier.

IMPORTANT: This must be a playable game with functional mechanics, not just a visual demonstration.

1. PLAYER AND CAMERA

- Third-person camera positioned behind the soldier.
- WASD or virtual joystick for movement.
- Mouse or touch controls to rotate the camera and aim.
- Shooting button.
- Reload button.
- Jump button.
- Sprint button.
- Melee attack button.
- Weapon switching.
- Responsive and smooth controls.

The character must have a large, intimidating and heavily armored appearance.

2. ASTARTES ARMOR CUSTOMIZATION

Create a customization menu where the player can modify the appearance of the soldier.

Allow customization of:

- Primary armor color.
- Secondary armor color.
- Helmet color.
- Shoulder armor color.
- Chest armor color.
- Leg armor color.
- Visor color.
- Metallic details.

Include a color picker with freely selectable colors.

Add preset colors:

- Black.
- White.
- Red.
- Purple.
- Gold.
- Silver.
- Dark Green.
- Blue.

Allow different helmets, shoulder pads and armor pieces to be unlocked.

All changes must be visible on the actual 3D character.

3. WEAPONS

Create a functional weapon system.

Available weapons:

- Assault Rifle.
- Heavy Machine Gun.
- Shotgun.
- Plasma Rifle.
- Sniper Rifle.
- Heavy Energy Cannon.
- Combat Pistol.
- Energy Sword.

Each weapon must have different damage, fire rate, ammunition capacity and reload speed.

The player starts with an Assault Rifle and unlocks additional weapons using credits earned during gameplay.

4. WAVE SURVIVAL SYSTEM

Create an arena survival mode with 10 initial waves.

Each wave must spawn enemies that actively hunt and attack the player.

Wave progression:

WAVE 1: Small groups of basic aliens.

WAVE 2: More enemies.

WAVE 3: Fast alien creatures.

WAVE 4: Ranged alien enemies.

WAVE 5: First elite alien.

WAVE 6: Larger enemy groups.

WAVE 7: Heavy armored aliens.

WAVE 8: Mixed enemy types and stronger enemies.

WAVE 9: Massive alien invasion.

WAVE 10: A gigantic alien boss with enormous health and powerful attacks.

After defeating Wave 10, unlock endless survival mode with progressively stronger enemies.

Display the current wave and remaining enemies on the screen.

Include a short preparation period between waves.

5. ALIEN ENEMIES

Create different alien enemy types:

- Crawler: small and fast creatures that attack in groups.
- Stalker: agile enemies that move quickly and flank the player.
- Spitter: ranged enemies that shoot corrosive projectiles.
- Brute: enormous creatures with high health and powerful melee attacks.
- Hunter: aggressive elite enemies.
- Overlord: gigantic boss with multiple attack patterns.

Each enemy must have functional AI, health, attack animations and damage.

Enemies must spawn around the arena and actively pursue the player.

6. CHARACTER PROGRESSION

The player earns XP and credits by killing enemies and completing waves.

Create an upgrade menu with these attributes:

- Health: increases maximum health.
- Armor: reduces incoming damage.
- Strength: increases melee damage.
- Weapon Damage: increases firearm damage.
- Accuracy: improves aiming precision.
- Reload Speed: reduces reload time.
- Movement Speed: increases mobility.
- Critical Chance: increases critical damage probability.
- Health Regeneration: slowly restores health.

Each attribute must have multiple upgrade levels.

The upgrades must have visible effects on gameplay.

7. SPECIAL ABILITIES

Give the player three special abilities:

GROUND BREAKER: A powerful ground attack that damages nearby enemies.

OVERDRIVE: Temporarily increases movement speed and weapon damage.

AEGIS SHIELD: Creates an energy shield that absorbs incoming damage.

Abilities must have cooldowns and functional visual effects.

8. REWARDS AND SHOP

Create an in-game shop accessible between waves.

Players can spend credits to:

- Purchase weapons.
- Unlock armor pieces.
- Upgrade attributes.
- Unlock special abilities.
- Purchase ammunition.
- Restore health.

Reward players for defeating enemies, elite enemies and bosses.

9. GAME INTERFACE

Create a futuristic military HUD.

Display:

- Health bar.
- Armor bar.
- Current wave.
- Remaining enemies.
- XP.
- Credits.
- Weapon name.
- Ammunition.
- Ability cooldowns.

Show large cinematic notifications when a new wave starts.

Example:

ASTARTES COMMAND
WAVE 05
HOSTILE CONTACT DETECTED

10. ENVIRONMENT

Create a dark futuristic military arena.

Include:

- Destroyed military structures.
- Alien ruins.
- Industrial facilities.
- Metallic platforms.
- Atmospheric fog.
- Dramatic lighting.
- Sparks and explosions.

The arena must provide enough room for movement, shooting and fighting large enemy groups.

11. VISUAL STYLE

High-quality dark sci-fi aesthetic.

The ASTARTES armor must look extremely heavy, sophisticated, intimidating and futuristic.

Use detailed 3D character models, realistic weapon proportions, dramatic lighting, muzzle flashes, explosions and impactful combat effects.

The aliens should look dangerous, grotesque and visually distinct.

12. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Prioritize a fully functional game.

Make sure:

- The player can move and aim.
- Weapons can shoot and reload.
- Bullets can damage enemies.
- Enemies can chase and attack the player.
- Enemies can die and disappear.
- Waves spawn correctly.
- Wave progression works.
- XP and credits are awarded.
- Upgrades actually affect attributes.
- Armor customization works.
- The game has a working start menu and game-over screen.
- The player's progression is saved whenever possible.

Optimize the game for smooth performance.

If all features cannot be implemented simultaneously, prioritize the playable third-person combat system, enemy AI, wave progression and character upgrades before adding secondary features.

FINAL GOAL:

Create an addictive third-person ASTARTES survival shooter where the player fights increasingly dangerous alien invasions, customizes a massive futuristic power armor, unlocks devastating weapons and evolves into an unstoppable extermination soldier.

ASTARTES — THE END OF EXISTENCE.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
